name: Yufo
description: A large, interdimensional jellyfishlike creature that floats in and out of the timestream.

abilities.name: Telepathic
abilities.description: The Yufo can mentally communicate with creatures within Very Far range.

abilities.name: Psychic Strongbox
abilities.description: The Yufo is immune to abilities and features that would affect or alter its thoughts or emotions.

abilities.name: Glitch Wave
abilities.description: Spend a Fear and choose up to three targets within Close range. Each target must succeed on a Instinct Reaction Roll or become desynced from reality and have disadvantage on Instinct Rolls until they use a downtime move to ground their psyches in the now.

abilities.name: Temporal Corrosion
abilities.description: When the Yufo succeeds on a standard attack, you can mark a Stress to have the Yufo excrete an entropic acid through its skin, giving the target a -2 penalty to their damage thresholds until they use a downtime move to repair their armor.
